interface.shortDescription: Contemplative reasoning — Lotus Sutra wisdom framework with journey visualization
interface.longDescription: Lotus Wisdom is a contemplative reasoning MCP server rooted in the Lotus Sutra wisdom framework. It guides structured, meditative problem-solving through contemplative domains (Hinayana, Mahayana, Vajrayana, Zen, Pure Land, Tiantai, and more), with an interactive journey visualization via MCP ext-apps. Runs entirely locally over stdio — the committed dist/bundle.js is fully self-contained, no npm install required.
